rawSiteProfile.name: Fulcrum Outdoors
rawSiteProfile.notes:
LightSpeed eCom (hosted on shoplightspeed.com). No active WAF: plain HTTP with default desktop Chrome UA returns 200 on category, product, and sitemap pages. Cloudflare is passive CDN only (cf-ray header present, no challenge). | Product count source: /sitemap.xml filtered to ^/<slug>.html$ = 3631 products (sitemap has 4456 total locs including categories/brands). 5 random HEAD samples all 200. | Pagination: suffix-replace — /firearms/ → /firearms/page2.html → /firearms/page3.html ... Real anchor hrefs in the <nav class="pagination"> block confirm this is the ONLY working pagination form. Query-style ?page= is silently ignored. | perPage verified = 12 products per category page. | Sort parameter: READ from actual HTML <select name="sort" id="sortselect">. Options: default, popular, newest, lowest, highest, asc, desc. Using value="newest" → first 5 products on /firearms/ change from {crusader, akdas, adler-rf224, sks, adler-rf224} to {adler-ad500, weatherby-vanguard, akdas-alcor, savage-axis, savage-revel} — proves sort works. Sort also survives pagination: /firearms/page2.html?sort=newest first 5 differ from both unsorted page 2 AND sorted page 1. | CatalogUrls: final minimum-overlap list of 8 firearm-relevant categories. Walked with production GenericRetailAdapter — unique dedupe total = 1665 products. Per-category raw counts: firearms=355, shooting=720, fire-arm-accessories=2 (mostly-dead legacy category), optics=295, custom-rifle-building=59 (28 new — heavy overlap with shooting), hunting=186, archery=61, cool-stuff=18 (contains Byrna launcher + tactical items). | DROPPED categories (with reasons): /apparel/ (49, hunting clothing not firearm-relevant), /camping/ (286, general camping), /e-bikes/ (20, bikes), /smokers/ (25, BBQ pellet grills), /fishing/ (590, fishing), /clearance/ (0 products — empty overlay). Dropping these brings GRAND UNIQUE from 2612 (all 14) down to 1665 (firearm-relevant only). The gap to sitemap 3631 is primarily fishing+camping+apparel+smokers+ebikes (~970) which are intentionally excluded per project priorities. | Watermark method: navigate-from-watermark — sort=newest works end-to-end. | Previous DB count of 50 products vs expected 3631 (1.4%) was due to broken pagination (suffix-replace was never configured) combined with wrong productCountMethod (stream-page-count) and needsPlaywright:true forcing unnecessary Playwright fetches. All four are now corrected.

[2026-04-07] Re-added /camping/ to catalogUrls after inspecting the 6 originally-dropped categories for firearm-adjacent products. /camping/ contains 2 unique firearm-related products not present in any other kept category: "Streamlight TRL-1 HL Gun Light" (weapon-mounted tactical light) and "Bakcou Gun/Bow Rack" (gun storage rack). The other 284 products are general camping gear, but walking the full category once per T1 cycle is the only reliable way to discover these 2 products. Other dropped categories (/apparel/, /e-bikes/, /smokers/, /fishing/, /clearance/) were re-verified to contain 0 unique firearm-related products (the /fishing/ "sling/rod/barrel" keyword matches were all fishing-specific false positives — fishing sling packs, fly rod holders, barrel swivels for tackle). /apparel/ is purely clothing (boots, jackets, gloves, socks) with 0 firearm items.

[2026-04-09] Retro-checked for Mistake 26 (LightSpeed ?page=N silent ignore). CONFIRMED AFFECTED: ?page=2 returns page-1 products. Fixed paginationPattern.match from ".html" to "?sort=newest" with template "page{N}.html?sort=newest". Verified page2.html?sort=newest returns different products from page 1 with zero overlap.

paginationPattern.notes: [2026-04-09 Mistake 26 retro-fix] LightSpeed silently ignores ?page=N. Pagination ONLY works via pageN.html suffix. When sortParam (?sort=newest) is appended by getNewArrivalsUrls, the match must anchor on the sort segment so buildPaginatedUrl strips and re-adds it correctly. Prior match was ".html" which failed when URL ended with "?sort=newest". Verified: ?page=2 returns page-1 products (silent ignore), page2.html?sort=newest returns correct page-2 products.

productCountMethod.notes: Single flat sitemap.xml contains 4456 <loc> entries. Filter to ^/<slug>.html$ yields product pages. HEAD-tested 5 random samples → all 200.
productCountMethod.filter: product URLs match /^\/[^/]+\.html$/ (flat slug at root, .html suffix)
